tests.title: A cancelled running attempt restores the request label within the grace
given: a job with request label af:fix on an issue carrying af:ready, a blocking brain, and the subscription removed after resolve
tests.when: the attempt's context is cancelled with a cancel cause, then with an unsubscribe cause
then: within 60 s in-progress is removed and af:fix is put back, af:ready stays, no status label and no comment are written
the lease is released and the session reported using the PAT read at resolve
the result carries the loop's envelope and labels set af:fix, removed in-progress
a cancel before the loop starts builds an envelope with category cancelled

tests.title: A shutdown writes nothing to the forge, keeps clone/ and releases the lease
given: a running attempt with in-progress set
tests.when: its context is cancelled with a shutdown cause
then: fakehub records no label or comment write after the cancel
clone/ remains
exactly one lease release is recorded
the session is completed within the shutdown wait

tests.title: The session's model, run id and the brain's model agree
given: a run with AF_MODEL unset and one with AF_MODEL=m1
tests.when: the attempt opens its session and the loop runs
then: the session model is the catalog's default Anthropic model id (or m1), the brain is passed it, and the usage record carries it
run_id matches YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<6 hex> and equals the envelope's run_id
the session opens before the in-progress mark

tests.title: A session that cannot open stops the attempt with no forge write and no lease
given: fakehub answering the session open with 503, then 401, then 403
tests.when: the attempt runs
then: 503 returns a transient error category hub retryable true
401 and 403 return a failed envelope with category auth
no label or comment is written and no lease is requested

tests.title: After release, one usage record, sequence-ordered 500-event batches and the completion are posted
given: a loop that emitted 1200 events with brain usage, and a transient-error attempt
tests.when: the attempt reports to hub
then: one usage record carries the model, brain, tokens, cost, cost source and turns
events arrive as three batches of 500, 500 and 200 in sequence order
the session is completed with the envelope's status, or failed under a transient error
no usage record is posted when no brain ran

tests.title: A failing usage, events or complete call adds a warning and nothing else changes
given: fakehub failing usage, events batch and session complete in turn
tests.when: the attempt returns
then: the envelope carries hub_usage_failed, hub_events_failed or hub_session_failed respectively
the status and other fields are unchanged
under a transient error the failure is logged

tests.title: Every request carries only its own attempt's credentials
given: sentinels in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN and GITLAB_TOKEN, a distinct PAT and lease token per workspace
tests.when: for any attempt (triage or fix, any outcome), including two run concurrently on two workspaces under go test -race
then: no request to hub, the git server or the gateway carries a sentinel
every box spec has an empty Env and no sentinel
every hub and git request carries only its workspace's PAT and every gateway request only its lease token
no environment lookup is read
tests.pseudocode: for scenario in gen_attempts(): run_concurrently(a,b); for r in fake.Requests(): assert r.cred in {a.pat} for a's; for s in specs: assert len(s.Env)==0

tests.title: Neither the PAT nor the lease token appears in any output or file after a full fix attempt
given: a full fix attempt on fakehub with known PAT and lease token
tests.when: the envelope, events, comments, every file under the attempt tree and every recorded Spec.Env are scanned
then: neither token is found anywhere

tests.title: fakehub serves the worker's endpoints and its git server accepts only the Basic PAT
given: fakehub with workspace, vars, issues, pulls, sessions and leases set
a git server credentialed for agent-fox:<PAT>
tests.when: each endpoint is called, failures are injected by route, and the git server is hit with a bearer token, a wrong user, a wrong password and the correct Basic header
then: endpoints serve the test-set state and every request is recorded and counted
injected failures apply per route
the bearer and other credentials get 401
a lease points at an in-process gateway whose backend records specs and commands

tests.title: Documentation describes the worker and make check passes including the docs tests
given: make doc has been run
tests.when: docs/architecture.md, configuration.md, model-usage.md, api.md, development.md and README.md are read and make check is run
then: each document contains the content required by 13-REQ-10.8
docs/cli.md is unchanged
make check passes, including the docs tests

tests.title: A fix attempt on issue 42 lands a pull request end to end
given: fakehub with a standard workspace and issue 42 carrying no status label
its git server, an in-process gateway over the local provider, and the scripted brain
tests.when: the worker runs a fix attempt on issue 42 with round position 1
then: a hub session opens and its session id and run id reach the recorder
af:in-progress is set, the clone comes from the git server, and the sandbox id is reported
fix/42-… is pushed, the branch push route is called, then POST …/pulls
one fix_summary comment is posted, af:landed set and af:in-progress removed
the lease is released, then usage, an events batch and the completion are posted
the envelope is done with pull request, hub_session and sandbox artifacts and labels af:landed set, af:in-progress removed

tests.title: A triage attempt replaces the body and sets ready end to end
given: fakehub with an issue, the gateway and a scripted brain submitting a probable diagnosis
tests.when: the worker runs a triage attempt on the issue
then: the body is replaced through hub and the ## Original report section is byte-identical to the original body
af:ready is set, af:in-progress removed and no comment posted
the lease is released and the session reported
the envelope is done with labels af:ready set

tests.title: A triage whose submission asks a question blocks on a person
given: fakehub with an issue and a scripted triage submission carrying a question with lettered options
tests.when: the worker runs a triage attempt on the issue
then: the envelope is needs_human
af:needs-human is set
exactly one comment holds the question, its lettered options and af jobs answer <job id>

tests.title: A fix on a carry_patch workspace is refused at resolve
given: fakehub with a carry_patch workspace and a counting brain
tests.when: the worker runs a fix attempt
then: the result envelope is failed with error.category unsupported and retryable false
fakehub records no clone, lease, session request, label or comment
the brain ran zero times

tests.title: A cancelled fix attempt restores the request label end to end
given: a fix job with request label af:fix on issue 42 carrying af:ready, a brain blocked in the loop
tests.when: the attempt's context is cancelled with a cancel cause
then: within the 60 s grace in-progress is removed, af:fix is put back and af:ready stays
no comment is posted
the lease is released and hub is reported to
the result's labels show af:fix set and af:in-progress removed

tests.title: A lease refused with 503 comes back as a transient error and is retried
given: fakehub answering the first lease request with 503 and the jobs layer's fake retry
tests.when: the worker runs a fix attempt
then: af:in-progress is removed, events are posted, the session is completed failed and clone/ is kept
the worker returns an error carrying a sandbox *toolio.Failure with retryable true and no envelope
the fake retry hands the same attempt over again
